transcript.content: Hello. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi, doctor. Thank you so much for fitting me in. Um... I guess I'm here because of some things going on at work. I really hope I don't sound, you know, difficult or anything, I always try to do a good job. 

But... well, dispatch and the compliance team have been tracking my route changes through the computer system. And there are these little comments they make on the radio. Um... when I mention it, people tell me it’s just normal oversight, and I try to just accept that, but... I can just tell that certain other drivers are reporting on me. 

Does that make sense? I just... I hope it's okay that I came in to talk about it. I want to make sure I'm doing the right thing by being here.
Aside from the radio comments you mentioned, have you ever heard voices or sounds that other people couldn't hear, or when nobody was around?

Oh, um... no. No, definitely not. I really hope you don't think I'm... well, imagining things. It's really just the actual radio at work, and the people there. 

When I'm alone in the cab or at home, it's just normal and quiet. I haven't heard any voices or strange sounds or anything like that. Does that help? I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right information, so I'm trying to be as accurate as I can for you.
About how long have you been noticing this happening with dispatch and the other drivers?

Um... well, I've really tried not to make a big deal out of it, because I always want to be easy to work with. But I'd say the tracking through the computer system and... and those radio comments... they've felt pretty clear to me for about the past two months. 

I really hope it doesn't sound like I'm just complaining or being paranoid. It's just been the last two months or so where it became really obvious to me. Is that... does that answer your question okay? I want to make sure I'm giving you the right details.
Have you ever felt like your thoughts were being interfered with, broadcast out loud, or that an outside force was controlling your mind or actions?

Oh, goodness, no. Um... definitely nothing like that. My thoughts are completely my own, and I'm always in control of what I do. I promise. 

I know talking about the dispatch tracking might make it seem like I'm... well, I just really don't want you to think I'm losing touch with reality or anything. It's just the actual computer system at work, not anything in my head. I haven't had any outside forces controlling me or anyone hearing my thoughts. 

I hope that's reassuring? I really just want to make sure I'm being helpful and giving you exactly what you need to know. Am I doing okay answering your questions?
